scenes.dialogue: Construction starts tomorrow on land you claim. Your suit may take years. Can a court freeze things today?
Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. That is what a temporary injunction under Order Thirty Nine of the Code of Civil Procedure is for.
scenes.shown: Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. That is what a temporary injunction under Order XXXIX of the Code of Civil Procedure is for.

scenes.dialogue: It is an interim order made while a suit is pending, preserving the position until the rights are decided.
Section Ninety Four, clause C, gives the power. Order Thirty Nine sets out how it is used.
scenes.shown: Section 94(c) gives the power. Order XXXIX sets out how it is used.

scenes.dialogue: A perpetual injunction, by contrast, is granted only by the decree, on the merits.
A hypothetical case. Anita sues her neighbour Naresh over a strip of land, and he starts digging foundations there.
Rule One covers disputed property in danger of being wasted, damaged or alienated, or wrongfully sold in execution of a decree.
scenes.shown: Rule 1 covers disputed property in danger of being wasted, damaged or alienated, or wrongfully sold in execution of a decree.

scenes.dialogue: It covers a defendant who threatens or intends to remove or dispose of his property to defraud his creditors.
Or threats to dispossess the plaintiff, or cause other injury in relation to the disputed property. That fits Anita.
Rule Two covers suits to restrain a breach of contract or other injury, on terms such as giving security.
scenes.shown: Rule 2 covers suits to restrain a breach of contract or other injury, on terms such as giving security.

scenes.dialogue: Fitting a situation is only the start. In Dalpat Kumar versus Prahlad Singh, the Supreme Court explained three tests.
First, a prima facie case: a bona fide, substantial question for trial. It is not prima facie title; title must be proved by evidence at the trial.
Second, irreparable injury: a material injury that damages cannot adequately compensate. A prima facie case alone is not enough.
Third, the balance of convenience: the court compares the mischief to each side if relief is refused, or if granted.
Anita's sale deed raises a serious question, and a short pause may cost Naresh less than a permanent structure would cost her.
Even then, the relief is discretionary and equitable, so the applicant's conduct counts.
In Gujarat Bottling versus Coca Cola, the Supreme Court said that conduct should be fair and honest, and free from blame.
Hiding a material fact, or waiting months while the walls rise, can count against Anita.
Now suppose Naresh plans to pour the concrete tomorrow morning. Must the court hear him first?
Rule Three makes notice to the other side the norm, unless the delay would defeat the very object of the injunction.
scenes.shown: Rule 3 makes notice to the other side the norm, unless the delay would defeat the very object of the injunction.

scenes.dialogue: Acting without notice, the court must record its reasons. In Morgan Stanley, the Supreme Court called such orders exceptional.
Anita must at once deliver, or send by registered post, copies of her application, affidavit, plaint and documents.
That day or the next, she must file an affidavit that the copies were delivered or sent.
Under Rule Three A, the court must try to finally decide the application within thirty days, or record why it could not.
scenes.shown: Under Rule 3A, the court must try to finally decide the application within 30 days, or record why it could not.

scenes.dialogue: Naresh can respond. Under Rule Four, any dissatisfied party may apply to discharge, vary or set aside the order.
scenes.shown: Naresh can respond. Under Rule 4, any dissatisfied party may apply to discharge, vary or set aside the order.

scenes.dialogue: An ex parte order resting on a knowingly false or misleading material statement must be vacated, unless the court records reasons not to.
If Naresh keeps building, Rule Two A lets the court attach his property and detain him in civil prison for up to three months.
scenes.shown: If Naresh keeps building, Rule 2A lets the court attach his property and detain him in civil prison for up to three months.

scenes.dialogue: Attachment cannot last beyond one year. If the breach continues, the property may be sold, and the injured party compensated.
Orders under Rules One, Two, Two A, Four and Ten are appealable under Order Forty Three, Rule One, clause R.
scenes.shown: Orders under Rules 1, 2, 2A, 4 and 10 are appealable under Order XLIII Rule 1(r).

scenes.dialogue: But in Wander versus Antox, the Supreme Court said an appeal court should not substitute its own discretion for the trial court's.
It interferes only if discretion was exercised arbitrarily, capriciously or perversely, or settled principles were ignored.
Suppose the wall is already up, and Anita wants it pulled down now. That is a mandatory interim injunction.
In Dorab Cawasji Warden, the Supreme Court required a strong case for trial, of a higher standard than a prima facie case.
It also needs irreparable or serious injury, and the balance of convenience in the applicant's favour.
Section Forty One of the Specific Relief Act lists cases where no injunction can be granted. Its bars reach interim relief too.
scenes.shown: Section 41 of the Specific Relief Act lists cases where no injunction can be granted. Its bars reach interim relief too.

scenes.dialogue: When drafting, prove each test with documents and an affidavit, since Rule One speaks of proof by affidavit or otherwise.
scenes.shown: When drafting, prove each test with documents and an affidavit, since Rule 1 speaks of proof by affidavit or otherwise.

scenes.dialogue: Seeking it without notice? Show the urgency, disclose every material fact, and finish the Rule Three steps on time.
scenes.shown: Seeking it without notice? Show the urgency, disclose every material fact, and finish the Rule 3 steps on time.

scenes.dialogue: Finally, check any local High Court amendments to Order Thirty Nine before you file.
scenes.shown: Finally, check any local High Court amendments to Order XXXIX before you file.
